svg.text: Plan koji EXPLAIN prikazuje kao savršen
SELECT id, created_at, amount FROM wide_events WHERE amount > 504.9 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10
wide_events, 5.000.000 torki · uslov ispunjava 940 njih, dakle 0,0188% · optimizator pretpostavlja 33,33%
1 · ŠTA EXPLAIN POKAŽE
type=index key=idx_created_at rows=10 filtered=33.33 Extra=Using where
-> Limit: 10 row(s) (cost=0.837 rows=3.33)
-> Filter: (wide_events.amount > 504.90) (cost=0.837 rows=3.33)
-> Index scan on wide_events using idx_created_at (cost=0.837 rows=10)
Nijedna kolona nije upozorenje. rows kaže 10, cena nije ni ceo broj, nema filesort, nema skena cele tabele.
2 · ŠTA EXPLAIN ANALYZE IZMERI
-> Limit: 10 row(s) (cost=0.837 rows=3.33) (actual time=328..2853 rows=10 loops=1)
-> Filter: (wide_events.amount > 504.90) (cost=0.837 rows=3.33) (actual time=328..2853 rows=10 loops=1)
-> Index scan on wide_events using idx_created_at (cost=0.837 rows=10) (actual time=2.27..2851 rows=31621 loops=1)
Isti plan, izvršen. Da bi našao tih 10 torki, sken preko indeksa pročitao je njih 31.621, i to je trajalo 2.853 ms.
3 · DRUGI PLAN, ZA POREĐENJE
-> Limit: 10 row(s) (cost=574636 rows=10) (actual time=1789..1789 rows=10 loops=1)
-> Sort: wide_events.created_at, limit input to 10 row(s) per chunk (cost=574636 rows=4.91e+6) (actual time=1789..1789 rows=10 loops=1)
-> Filter: (wide_events.amount > 504.90) (cost=574636 rows=4.91e+6) (actual time=2.66..1789 rows=940 loops=1)
-> Table scan on wide_events (cost=574636 rows=4.91e+6) (actual time=0.773..1578 rows=5e+6 loops=1)
IGNORE INDEX oduzima idx_created_at. EXPLAIN mu daje cenu 574.636 naspram 0,84, a izmereno traje 1.789 ms.
procena 10 torki · stvarno 31.621 · odstupanje 3.162×
Plan kome EXPLAIN daje cenu 0,84 traje 2.853 ms; plan kome daje cenu 574.636, dakle 686.542 puta veću, traje 1.789 ms.
Bez izvršavanja se to nije moglo videti. To je jedini razlog zbog kog EXPLAIN ANALYZE postoji.
